name: Home Depot Kids Workshop
address: Most Home Depot stores (Van Nuys area)
schedule: First Saturday of each month, 9 AM - noon. Kids build a free wood kit.
notes: Best for ages 5-12. Register online to guarantee a kit.

name: Griffith Observatory Public Star Party
address: Griffith Observatory, 2800 E Observatory Rd, Los Angeles, CA 90027
schedule: Monthly on a Saturday, 2 - 9:45 PM. Volunteer astronomers set up telescopes on the lawn.
notes: Free, no reservation listed. Good for Astronomy merit badge and Cub space adventures.

name: Santa Monica Mountains Trails Council - Trail Work Days
address: Santa Monica Mountains (Malibu Creek, Point Mugu and other parks)
schedule: Trail maintenance most Saturdays and some weekdays, about 8 AM - 2 PM. Tools and training provided.
notes: Public volunteer day. Check the youth age and supervision rules before bringing a group.

name: SFV Audubon - Sepulveda Basin Bird Walk
address: Sepulveda Basin Wildlife Area, 6350 Woodley Ave, Van Nuys, CA 91406
schedule: First Sunday of each month, 8 - 11 AM, from the Woodley Park amphitheater.
notes: Canceled in rain or flooding; call 747-237-3720 to check. Good for Bird Study.
